snippet.title: Tommygun's Frag - Global Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now! 🔴 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2483340

Frag is a game about dominating your opponents by unlocking better weapons before they do!  Think gun-game x battlefield but 

Squad up and join the battlefield! Start with a pistol, frag enemies, secure objectives, and unlock an arsenal—from SMGs to attack helicopters. Every match resets progression—new tactics, new loadouts, same relentless gunplay. Gun-game meets Battlefield in this fast and chaotic PvP FPS!
